title: Cash-poor Beta needs liquidity for New York
description: Cash-poor Beta needs liquidity for New York. Beta is cash-poor, so the cash sweetener matters more than face value. The offer has to be credible to the counterparty while preserving Alpha's actual strategic edge.

final_action.public_message: Hey Beta, I'd like to buy New York Avenue from you for $200. Let me know if that works for you!
final_action.private_thought: Acquiring New York Avenue completes my orange set (St James Place, Tennessee Avenue, New York Avenue), enabling house building and increasing rent. Offering $200 gives Beta a nice cash boost while preserving my liquidity.
